decks.notes: The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly deploy low-cost, efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to maintain a fast tempo by utilizing cards like Runaway Steam-Kin and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to keep the board clear while dealing damage. Pia Nalaar helps provide additional threats while removal spells like Chained to the Rocks deal with opposing creatures. Showdown of the Skalds provides card advantage and pumps up the team, while Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion for additional value.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and generating card advantage with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also utilizes the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. With a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful finishers like Shark Typhoon, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win conditions. The mana base is carefully crafted to ensure consistent access to both colors while also providing utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with instant and sorcery spells, in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix multiple times for a relentless aggressive strategy. The deck features a mix of cheap removal spells and card draw to support this game plan, with options to protect the Phoenix with counterspells like Spell Pierce. The inclusion of cards like Ledger Shredder and Pieces of the Puzzle help dig deeper into the deck to find key pieces, while Treasure Cruise provides additional card advantage to maintain momentum.

Utilizing the sacrifice mechanic to generate value and control the board with Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa. The deck focuses on recurring creatures and generating advantage through sacrificing and reanimating them, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal and hand disruption spells. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana fixing and a powerful late-game threat, while the land base allows for flexibility in casting spells and activating abilities. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and resource denial.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp into powerful green creatures and planeswalkers, while also generating a high devotion to green to maximize the value of cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. The aggressive nature of the deck is further supported by cards like Storm the Festival and Old-Growth Troll, allowing for a fast and efficient way to overwhelm opponents. Additionally, the inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures provides versatile answers to various threats, making it a well-rounded and formidable deck in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Rakdos Aggro utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to apply pressure. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. With a mix of creatures, removal, and disruption, Rakdos Aggro aims to constantly apply pressure and end the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize sacrifice effects and steal opponent's creatures to control the board and deal damage. Mayhem Devil is a key card in this strategy, triggering whenever a permanent is sacrificed, along with Cauldron Familiar to generate consistent value. Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing key threats from the opponent, while cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize help disrupt their game plan. Jegantha, the Wellspring acts as a powerful companion to provide additional value and flexibility in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy a wide board of spirit creatures and control the game through tempo plays. By utilizing efficient creatures like Rattlechains and Spell Queller, along with disruptive spells like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare, the deck aims to apply pressure while also disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Curious Obsession and Invasion of Gobakhan provides card advantage and additional threats to overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of flying creatures and counter spells, the deck seeks to outpace opponents and secure victory through aggressive tactics and efficient resource management.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels onto the battlefield. It also includes various spells to control the board and protect the combo pieces, while also incorporating Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Secrets of the Key for additional synergy. The goal is to set up a game-winning play by combining creativity with a touch of unpredictability, creating a unique and explosive playstyle that aims to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their spells, removing their threats, and drawing into more answers. It also utilizes powerful finishers like Torrential Gearhulk and Shark Typhoon to close out the game. The deck's strategy revolves around maintaining control of the board and resources while gradually gaining advantage over the opponent. It aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through efficient and versatile spells.

The deck revolves around using the Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II combo to create a powerful board presence and generate value. It also utilizes cards like Raffine's Informant and Grisly Salvage to dig for combo pieces while disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Sorin, Vengeful Bloodlord to provide additional value and control. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency in casting spells and activating abilities.

This deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures to trigger effects that deal damage to the opponent, while also disrupting their game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The key strategy is to constantly pressure the opponent with cheap creatures and sacrifice outlets like Witch's Oven, generating value with cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar. Additionally, the deck includes Claim the Firstborn to steal the opponent's creatures and use them for sacrifice effects. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and disruptive, overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creature threats and removal spells.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with low-cost Spirit creatures while utilizing tempo plays and disruption to control the board. By leveraging powerful Spirit synergies and evasion abilities, the deck looks to pressure opponents early and maintain a strong board presence while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Curious Obsession and Invasion of Gobakhan helps to draw cards and generate additional value, while cards like Spell Queller and Shacklegeist provide disruptive elements to slow down opponents and protect key creatures. The deck aims to close out games quickly and efficiently through a combination of combat damage and disruption.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly establish board presence with tempo plays using evasive Spirit creatures and disruptive spells, while also drawing cards with Curious Obsession to maintain momentum. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early while controlling the board with counterspells and removal. By consistently deploying threats and protecting them, the deck can outmaneuver opponents and close out games efficiently. Additionally, the deck utilizes a mix of lands and creature types to maximize synergy and utility in various game situations.

The main concept of this deck is to flood the board with cheap, aggressive creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to pump up the team, along with protective spells like Brave the Elements, the deck aims to maintain pressure and control the battlefield. Wedding Announcement acts as a pseudo-anthem effect, boosting the power of all creatures. The deck's mana base includes utility lands like Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale to support the aggressive strategy.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient army of low-cost creatures. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck can quickly build a powerful battlefield presence. Cards like Brave the Elements and Ossification provide protection and removal options to keep the pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale allow for additional creature generation and strategic advantages. Overall, this deck aims to maintain a relentless assault on the opponent while utilizing synergies between its creatures to secure victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells and removal while generating card advantage with cards like Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to further control the game. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and synergies with the deck's blink effects. The mana base is built to support the control strategy with a mix of lands that provide different utility options.
